choices.content: They are similar because two pairs of corresponding angles are equal.
They are similar because all three pairs of corresponding sides are proportional.

question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\) and \(\triangle DEF\), \(\angle A=\angle D\) and \(\angle B=\angle E\). Are the triangles similar? Select the correct conclusion.

solutions.explanation: Two triangles with two pairs of equal corresponding angles are similar (AA). No condition on the sides is needed.
solutions.title: Apply AA similarity
